source_audit.publisher: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) via NYC Open Data
source_audit.description: Contains information pertaining to permit applications for work to landmark sites submitted to and processed by LPC.
source_audit.source_type: administrative permit/application records for work on landmark properties and historic districts
source_audit.license_terms: NYC Open Data / NYC.gov Terms of Use; no dataset-specific CC-style license found in reviewed metadata.
source_audit.terms_notes: NYC Open Data terms identify public datasets as informational, without warranty, and subject to agency updates/corrections; submitting agencies are authoritative.
source_audit.target_time_window: 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19 inclusive, implemented as issue_date >= 2008-01-01 and issue_date < 2026-05-20.
selection_queries: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/dpm2-m9mq.json?$where=issue_date between '2008-01-01T00:00:00' and '2026-05-20T00:00:00' and regulation_type='Certificate of Appropriateness' and lower(worktypes) like '%new building%'

https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/dpm2-m9mq.json?$where=issue_date between '2008-01-01T00:00:00' and '2026-05-20T00:00:00' and regulation_type='Certificate of Appropriateness' and (lower(worktypes) like '%rooftop addition%' or lower(worktypes) like '%rear yard addition%' or lower(worktypes) like '%demolition%')

https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/dpm2-m9mq.json?$where=issue_date between '2008-01-01T00:00:00' and '2026-05-20T00:00:00' and regulation_type='Certificate of Appropriateness' and (lmnametype like '%Individual Landmark%' or lmnametype like '%Interior Landmark%' or lmnametype like '%Scenic Landmark%')
source_audit.geographic_scope: New York City landmark sites, individual/interior/scenic landmarks, and historic districts represented in LPC permit rows.
source_audit.granularity: Permit/application row; some regulation numbers can appear on multiple address rows in the full dataset, so regulation_number plus address should be checked during ingestion.
required_caveats: Permits are administrative records and not evidence of physical completion.
COFA indicates Commission-level review/appropriateness approval; it is not a claim that work occurred.
WorkTypes are normalized/category text, not a full scope narrative.
Coordinates may be missing or approximate; use BBL/address as fallback geometry reference.
Dataset can be updated/corrected after access date.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Ingest selected COFA rows as documented administrative permit action events with source row URL, issue/received/expiration dates, location fields, worktypes, and explicit non-completion caveat.

source_audit.source_type: official explanatory page for LPC permit categories
source_audit.use_in_round: Context source for interpreting Certificate of Appropriateness, Certificate of No Effect, Permit for Minor Work, and staff/Commission-level review distinctions.
required_caveats: Use for permit-type interpretation only; candidate facts come from the NYC Open Data rows.
